_doc: R24 T2 — the FROZEN specimen set for the core-first before/after comparison. Gate condition 1: T6 regenerates and T7 re-audits THESE EXACT job ids. Never re-resolve by lesson name — before/after integrity depends on identical jobs.
_corpus: homework_jobs status='done', output_language='uz', subject='history' (362 packets, 50 of them span>=7pp)

_selection_rationale.control_pairing: L1, L2 and S1 all come from the SAME book (6129e3df, '8-sinf O'zbekiston tarixi 2023') — same book, same authors, same grade — so lesson SPAN is the only variable between the long specimens and the short control. This is the load-bearing comparison.
_selection_rationale.single_book_guard: L3 is drawn from a DIFFERENT book and grade (c6891154, grade 10) so a result cannot be an artifact of one book's writing style.
_selection_rationale.L1_is_the_reproducible_worst_case: L1 was audited 3 independent times pre-tiering and returned 0 of 17 objectives learned every run, with essentially every objective marked coverage=taught.
